name: Can you paint over bathroom tiles?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint over bathroom tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can paint over bathroom tiles, but it requires specific preparation and products to ensure durability. The tiles must be thoroughly cleaned, degreased, and lightly sanded to create a profile for adhesion. A specialized epoxy or bonding primer designed for tile surfaces is essential, followed by a durable, moisture-resistant topcoat, such as a high-quality enamel or specific tile paint. This approach can refresh a bathroom's look without the cost of full tile replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, bathroom tiles can be painted with proper preparation, specialized primers, and durable, moisture-resistant paint.
